paragraphs.text: Hi — this is Bram. Thanks for poking around tetsagdasdjasd
Normally I'd open with “multi-disciplinary maker, builds web things, shoots photos, designs the odd brand.” True, but a little dull.
So instead, the honest version: I work across code, design and image because I get bored doing only one. Some of it ships, some of it lives forever in an “untitled” folder.
I taught myself to code before I learned to finish things.
Double-click the folders. The CV is the boring summary; the projects are the real me.
